description: First-person plural marketing voice and second-person reader-address; both forbidden by Coroboros pronoun rules.
brand_voice_yaml:
voice:
  name: "Coroboros"
  last_updated: "2026-04-27"
  source: "manual"

forbidden_lexicon: []

rewrite_rules:
  - reject: "foo"
    accept: "bar"
    rule_id: stub

sentence_norms:
  word_count_min: 8
  word_count_max: 18
  sentence_max_hard: 25

pronouns:
  default: "third-person institutional"
  forbid:
    - "first-person plural in marketing"
    - "second-person 'you' in marketing"
